subject.title: Group reply pipeline silently drops agent-generated payload between turn completion and Telegram sendMessage

question: Should OpenClaw adopt guarded default recovery for substantive source-channel finals that miss `message(action=send)`, or keep `message_tool_only` as diagnostics-only privacy behavior while handling Telegram no-send variants separately?
rationale: Current main intentionally keeps `message_tool_only` finals private, while the user-visible failure is silent message loss; choosing recovery versus diagnostics-only changes source-channel privacy and delivery semantics.

options.title: Adopt guarded recovery
options.body: Land or sponsor the bounded recovery direction from the open successor PR after maintainer review, preserving room-event, send-policy, and private-text guardrails.

options.title: Keep diagnostics-only
options.body: Preserve the current privacy contract and close only the documented/configured `message_tool_only` slice after improving docs and diagnostics.

options.title: Split by failure slice
options.body: Keep this issue as a tracker and require separate current-main live Telegram proof for reaction, identity, and preview/no-send variants before deciding recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded recovery
recommendation.body: Land or sponsor the bounded recovery direction from the open successor PR after maintainer review, preserving room-event, send-policy, and private-text guardrails.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available routing candidate across current main blame, message_tool_only policy wording, and Telegram/reply delivery history.
